The colour of the notification shade and other apps is set by the system. Turn on dark mode (choose the darkest level if offered). On Android 12+ the shade palette follows the wallpaper colour, so a black wallpaper makes it more neutral.
Offline recognition needs a downloaded language pack. Without it, voice search works only online.

Already downloaded the models (for example, for the keyboard)? Choose the files — you can select all three at once; the language is detected automatically. Otherwise download them in the browser and open the file with BlackLaunch. Models work without internet and only while you are speaking.

Tap a profile to make it active. On the home screen swipe left or right to switch, or say “mode work”.
Sound and notifications are saved now and will be applied when switching profiles in the next version.
The last profile cannot be deleted
Restrict other apps in the background
Apps that are not on this profile. Tap one to open its battery settings and choose “Restricted” — it will then not work in the background until you open it. You only need to do this once.
Saves battery: apps you do not need here stop working in the background. Killing apps does not help — they restart and use even more power.
Tip for an older battery: turn on charge protection (charge limit around 80%) in the system battery settings — it slows down battery wear the most.
Contacts, calendar and SMS are searched only while you type and only with your permission. SMS: chats in Google Messages (RCS) are not available to other apps — only regular SMS are found.
Permission not granted — this source stays off
Android blocks SMS access for apps not installed from Play. In the BlackLaunch app info that opens now, tap ⋮ → “Allow restricted settings”, then turn SMS on again.
Black wallpaper, grey icons, dark theme
Calculator, settings, shortcuts, contacts, calendar, SMS
A minimal offline launcher: no internet permission, no ads, no tracking. Everything stays on this phone.
Your own names for apps: long-press an app in the search results.
To stop apps that are not in a profile from working in the background: Home screen → Profiles → a profile → “Restrict other apps in the background”.
Apps on the home screen: long-press an icon and drag it to any place — top, centre, a corner. If another app is there, they swap. Each profile has its own layout.
How to turn on SMS search

Android 15 and newer (and some Android 13–14 phones), when BlackLaunch is not installed from Play: Android blocks SMS access until you allow it. 1) Try to turn on “SMS” above once. 2) Open the BlackLaunch app info (button below). 3) Tap ⋮ in the top right → “Allow restricted settings” and confirm with your PIN or fingerprint. 4) Come back and turn on “SMS” again.
Android 14 and older: just turn on “SMS” above and allow access when asked.
